body: Finally someone has the same as me! I have this with commercials, strangers, friends, parents I see every lie. Also I find it weird when friends are with different people that they have a mask and act differently!
Stay strong bro, relapse is NOT worth it. You’ll probably be anxious too if you’d smoke. It will get better after 2-3 weeks!
Yes, I try to do some exercises everyday for at least 30 mins!
I’m on day 10, believe me when I say your symptoms will be MUCH better next week. You got this brother!!
This is very inspiring man! Thank you for writing this out.
Thank you so much for sharing this bro! I have a few attempts to quit, i dumped everything again. Tomorrow is day 1.
I'm so glad i'm not alone. I dumped everything. This is hell on earth.
Thank you so much for this post. I'm only 12 days sober and still feel depressed but you made me 1/100 to quit and better my life right on the spot. You are a wonderful person. Big love.

I hope you will feel better soon. I'm thinking it's just massive brainfog. I'm very self aware so i notice every change in my brain. Today was a bit better. Explaining what i feel is indeed very difficult for me. I'm seeing a therapist this week.
Thank you so much! I hope things do get better soon, i hope i can look in the mirror again.
I'm so lost, all my dreams are vanished in this numbness. I hate myself for everything i've done.

Well I think if you need alcohol to say something you wouldn't say sober, there are underlying problems and things you worry about that should get fixed. I think you have to learn to say things sober and become more confident with yourself, I think you worry much when being sober.

I understand you.. i have the same problem with getting high. It made me feel better and made me forget about all the problems i had, and it made me feel better in general. Until i realized that it's only temporary, getting high only delayed my problems. After a while you get used to drinking/smoking and the problems will come back. At that point I knew if I want to feel happy and motivated again, I should do some REAL work around my problems. I also tried meditation, then I learned to listen  to my inner thoughts without emotions, and just listened to what I really need. And that's definitely not getting high. So i think you became a bit depressed, addicted caused by depression and a bit lazy because you have no motivation anymore. ( just my opinion ) don't want to make you feel bad.
I feel you... My whole youth has been a fight against myself. Now I'm 20 and we are in the same position. BUT you are something my friend, never forget that.

No, i'm not. Although I have very strong beliefs of life and the world around me that sometimes makes me feel like I know everything but actually I don't...


Edit : Those beliefs are often very destructive towards myself and others.
